topics.t: Should Japan accept more workers from other countries?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 人口が減って、介護や農業で働く人が足りない
理由2: 多様な考えが新しいアイデアや経済の成長につながる
まとめ: 受け入れの準備(言語・生活の支援)も大切
qs: What kinds of support do foreign workers need when they come to Japan?
Do you think language barriers are a serious problem in the workplace?

topics.t: Is space exploration worth its cost?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 衛星の技術が天気予報や通信など生活を支えている
理由2: 新しい技術が医療や環境の分野にも使われる
まとめ: 国どうしの協力で費用を分け合える
qs: Should private companies play a bigger role in space exploration?
Some people say the money should be spent on problems on Earth. What do you think?

topics.t: Can technology solve the problem of climate change?
outline: 立場: 一部は解決できる
理由1: 再生可能エネルギーや電気自動車で排出を減らせる
理由2: しかし技術だけでは不十分で、生活の変化も必要
まとめ: 技術と個人・政府の行動の両方が必要
qs: What can individuals do to reduce their carbon footprint?
Should air travel be more expensive to protect the environment?

topics.t: Should cities limit the use of cars in their centers?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 渋滞と大気汚染が減る
理由2: 歩きやすい街は店や観光にも良い
まとめ: 公共交通を便利にすることが条件
qs: How would limiting cars affect people who live in the suburbs?
Do you think public transportation in Japan is good enough?

topics.t: Are online friendships as meaningful as face-to-face ones?
outline: 立場: No(同じではない)
理由1: 表情や体験を共有することで信頼が深まる
理由2: ただしオンラインは遠くの人や同じ趣味の人とつながれる
まとめ: 両方の良さを組み合わせるのが大切
qs: Do social media sites make people feel lonely?
Should schools teach students how to use social media safely?

steps.t: All right. Here is your topic card. You have one minute to choose one topic and prepare your speech. You can't take notes.
All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.
Thank you. That is the end of the question period.

topics.t: Should more university classes in Japan be taught in English?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 国際的に活躍できる人材を育てられる
理由2: 海外からの留学生や研究者を呼びやすくなる
まとめ: 内容の理解を助けるサポートも必要
qs: Wouldn't students understand difficult subjects better in Japanese?
Should English be taught from a younger age in Japan?

topics.t: Is globalization a threat to local cultures?
outline: 立場: No(脅威だけではない)
理由1: 海外からの関心が伝統文化を守る力になる(観光・ファン)
理由2: ただし大きなチェーン店などで町の個性が失われることもある
まとめ: 地域が自分たちの文化の価値を発信することが大切
qs: Can you give an example of a local tradition that is disappearing?
Should governments protect traditional industries from foreign competition?

topics.t: Should companies have a fixed retirement age?
outline: 立場: No
理由1: 年齢ではなく能力と健康で判断すべき
理由2: 人手不足の中、経験のある人の力が必要
まとめ: 働き方を選べる柔軟な制度が良い
qs: How can companies make use of older workers' experience?
Would older people continuing to work reduce opportunities for young people?

topics.t: Will artificial intelligence create more jobs than it destroys?
outline: 立場: 長い目で見ればYes
理由1: 産業革命のように、新しい技術は新しい仕事を生んできた
理由2: ただし変化の間に仕事を失う人を支える必要がある
まとめ: 学び直し(リスキリング)の支援がカギ
qs: What kinds of jobs do you think are most at risk from AI?
Who should pay for retraining workers who lose their jobs?

topics.t: Should more be done to protect endangered species?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 生態系のバランスが崩れると、食料や薬など人間の生活にも影響する
理由2: 一度絶滅した種は二度と戻らない
まとめ: 生息地の保護と国際協力が必要
qs: Are zoos an effective way to protect endangered animals?
Should economic development ever come before protecting nature?

steps.t: All right. Here is your topic card. You have one minute to choose one topic and prepare your speech. You can't take notes.
All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.
Thank you. That is the end of the question period.

topics.t: Is a four-day workweek realistic for Japan?
outline: 立場: 一部の業界ではYes
理由1: 休みが増えると集中力と生産性が上がるという試みの結果がある
理由2: しかし医療やサービス業などは人手不足で難しい
まとめ: 業界ごとに柔軟に取り入れるべき
qs: Do Japanese people work too much?
How would a shorter workweek affect small businesses?

topics.t: Should advertising aimed at children be restricted?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 子どもは広告と情報の区別がつきにくい
理由2: お菓子やゲームの課金の広告が、健康やお金の問題につながる
まとめ: 親と学校がメディアの見方を教えることも大切
qs: Who is mainly responsible for what children watch: parents or companies?
Are online influencers a bad influence on young viewers?

topics.t: Are international sporting events worth the cost of hosting them?
outline: 立場: 条件付きでYes
理由1: 観光客が増え、国の魅力を世界に発信できる
理由2: しかし大会後に使われない施設が残るなど、費用の問題がある
まとめ: 今ある施設を使うなど、費用を抑える工夫が必要
qs: What should happen to stadiums after the event is over?
Do sporting events help improve relations between countries?

topics.t: Should the number of tourists be limited at popular destinations?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 混雑やごみで住民の生活が苦しくなる(オーバーツーリズム)
理由2: 自然や文化財が傷つくのを防げる
まとめ: 予約制や入場料で、量より質の観光へ
qs: Should foreign tourists pay higher prices than local people at tourist sites?
How can tourists be encouraged to visit less famous places?

topics.t: Is it important to preserve traditional crafts in modern society?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 地域の歴史や技術を次の世代に伝えられる
理由2: 手作りの良さは海外でも評価され、地域経済の力になる
まとめ: 若い職人を育てる支援と、新しいデザインとの組み合わせ
qs: Why do you think fewer young people become craftspeople?
Can modern technology help traditional crafts survive?

steps.t: All right. Here is your topic card. You have one minute to choose one topic and prepare your speech. You can't take notes.
All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.
Thank you. That is the end of the question period.

topics.t: Should high-speed trains replace short-distance flights?
outline: 立場: 一部の路線ではYes
理由1: 鉄道は飛行機よりCO2の排出が少ない
理由2: 街の中心の駅から乗れるので、合計の移動時間が短いこともある
まとめ: 島や遠い地域には飛行機が必要なので、使い分けが大切
qs: Which do you prefer for long trips in Japan, trains or planes?
How do you think air travel will change in the next twenty years?

topics.t: Should people have the right to have their personal information removed from the Internet?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 昔の失敗や個人情報がずっと残ると、仕事や生活に影響する
理由2: プライバシーは大切な権利
まとめ: ただし公共の利益(政治家の記録など)とのバランスが必要
qs: Do people share too much about themselves on social media?
Should search engine companies decide what information to remove?

topics.t: Should Japan invest more in renewable energy?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 輸入に頼る燃料が減り、エネルギーが安定する
理由2: 温室効果ガスを減らせる
まとめ: 天気に左右される弱点は、電気をためる技術で補う
qs: What kind of renewable energy is most suitable for Japan?
Should people pay more for electricity to support clean energy?

topics.t: Is it acceptable to use animals in scientific research?
outline: 立場: 厳しい条件付きでYes
理由1: 新しい薬やワクチンの安全性の確認に役立ってきた
理由2: ただし動物の苦痛を最小限にする責任がある
まとめ: コンピューターや培養細胞など、代わりの方法の開発を進める
qs: Should cosmetics companies be allowed to test products on animals?
Do you think technology can completely replace animal testing?

topics.t: Should computer programming be a required subject in elementary schools?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 筋道を立てて考える力が身につく
理由2: これからの社会でデジタルの知識は欠かせない
まとめ: 先生の研修と、ほかの教科とのバランスが必要
qs: Are there enough teachers who can teach programming?
Do children spend too much time using computers and tablets?

All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.
Thank you. That is the end of the question period.

topics.t: Is a university degree necessary for success today?
outline: 立場: No(必ずしも必要ではない)
理由1: オンライン講座や仕事の経験で専門的なスキルを身につけられる
理由2: ただし医師やパイロットのように専門の教育や資格が必要な仕事もある
まとめ: 目標に合わせて学び方を選ぶことが大切
qs: Should companies stop caring about which university applicants went to?
Is university education too expensive in Japan?

topics.t: Should cities spend more money on public spaces such as parks?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 運動や休息の場になり、住民の健康に良い
理由2: 地域の人どうしの交流が生まれる
まとめ: 災害のときの避難場所としても役立つ
qs: How can parks be made more useful for elderly people?
Should some parks be used for housing in crowded cities?

topics.t: Will remote work change where people choose to live?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 毎日通勤しなくてよいので、家賃の安い地方に住める
理由2: 地方の人口が増え、地域の経済が元気になる可能性がある
まとめ: ただし通信環境や仕事の種類によって差がある
qs: What are the disadvantages of working from home?
Should companies let employees choose where they work?

topics.t: Should genetically modified foods be more widely accepted?
outline: 立場: 安全の確認を条件にYes
理由1: 病気や乾燥に強い作物で、食料不足を減らせる
理由2: 農薬の使用を減らせる場合もある
まとめ: 表示をわかりやすくして、消費者が選べるようにする
qs: Why do you think many consumers are worried about genetically modified foods?
How can the world solve the problem of food shortages?

topics.t: Is international cooperation the key to solving global health problems?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 感染症は国境をこえて広がるので、一つの国だけでは防げない
理由2: 技術やワクチンを分け合うと、世界全体が安全になる
まとめ: 国際機関を通じた情報の共有と資金の協力が必要
qs: Should rich countries do more to help poorer countries improve their health care?
What lessons did the world learn from the COVID-19 pandemic?

All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.
Thank you. That is the end of the question period.

topics.t: Should the government introduce a universal basic income?
outline: 立場: No(今はまだ早い)
理由1: 全員に支給するには莫大な財源が必要で、増税が避けられない
理由2: 本当に困っている人への支援が薄くなるおそれ
まとめ: まずは対象をしぼった支援を充実させるべき
qs: Do you think a basic income would make people less willing to work?
How should the government support people who lose their jobs because of automation?

topics.t: Is the media responsible for the spread of misinformation?
outline: 立場: 一部は責任がある
理由1: 注目を集めるために、確認不十分な情報を流すことがある
理由2: ただしSNSで個人が広める情報の影響のほうが大きい
まとめ: メディアの責任と、受け手のメディアリテラシーの両方が必要
qs: How can people tell whether information online is reliable?
Should social media companies be punished for false information on their platforms?

topics.t: Should wealthy countries do more to help developing countries?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 貧困や感染症は国境を越えて世界全体に影響する
理由2: 教育やインフラへの支援は、長い目で見ると貿易の相手を育てる
まとめ: お金だけでなく技術や人材の協力も大切
qs: What kind of aid do you think is the most effective?
Some people say aid makes countries dependent. What do you think?

topics.t: Can economic growth and environmental protection go hand in hand?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 再生可能エネルギーなど環境分野が新しい産業と雇用を生む
理由2: 省エネは企業のコスト削減にもつながる
まとめ: 政府のルールと投資で両立を後押しすべき
qs: Should consumers pay more for environmentally friendly products?
Which industries will find it hardest to become green?

topics.t: Should the use of facial recognition technology be restricted?
outline: 立場: Yes(厳しいルールが必要)
理由1: 本人の知らないうちに行動が記録され、プライバシーが侵される
理由2: 誤認識によって無実の人が疑われるおそれ
まとめ: 使える場面とデータの扱いを法律で決めるべき
qs: Are there situations where facial recognition is clearly useful?
Who should be able to access the data collected by security cameras?

steps.t: All right. Here is your topic card. You have one minute to choose one topic and prepare your speech. You can't take notes.
All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.
Thank you. That is the end of the question period.

topics.t: Is the declining birth rate the biggest challenge facing Japan?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 働き手が減り、経済の規模が小さくなる
理由2: 年金や医療を支える人が減り、社会保障が厳しくなる
まとめ: 子育て支援と働き方の改革を同時に進めるべき
qs: Why do you think many young people in Japan are not having children?
Can immigration solve the problems caused by a shrinking population?

topics.t: Should nuclear power play a role in Japan's energy future?
outline: 立場: 一時的には必要
理由1: 発電時に二酸化炭素をほとんど出さず、安定して電気を作れる
理由2: しかし事故のリスクと廃棄物の問題は解決していない
まとめ: 再生可能エネルギーを増やすまでのつなぎとして使うべき
qs: How can the government gain public trust on energy policy?
What should be done with nuclear waste?

topics.t: Do celebrities have a responsibility to be role models?
outline: 立場: Yes(ある程度は)
理由1: 若者は有名人の行動や発言をまねしやすい
理由2: 影響力を社会問題の発信に使うこともできる
まとめ: ただし私生活まで完璧を求めるのは行きすぎ
qs: Should celebrities express their political opinions in public?
Do you think social media influencers have more influence than traditional celebrities?

topics.t: Should plastic packaging be banned?
outline: 立場: 一部は禁止すべき
理由1: 使い捨てのプラスチックは海の汚染の大きな原因
理由2: ただし食品の安全や保存に必要な場面もある
まとめ: 不要な包装から段階的に減らし、代わりの素材を広める
qs: Who should pay for the cost of switching to new materials?
Do you think recycling is an effective solution?

topics.t: Is it ethical to edit human genes?
outline: 立場: 病気の治療のためなら認めるべき
理由1: 遺伝性の病気に苦しむ人を救える可能性がある
理由2: しかし能力や外見を選ぶ目的での利用は不平等を生む
まとめ: 国際的なルールで使い道を厳しく制限すべき
qs: Where should we draw the line between treatment and enhancement?
Should scientists be free to do any research they want?

All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.
Thank you. That is the end of the question period.

topics.t: Should schools focus more on practical life skills?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: お金の管理や料理など、社会に出てすぐ必要な力を学べる
理由2: 教科の知識は今ではインターネットで調べられる
まとめ: 基礎教科とのバランスを取りながら時間を増やすべき
qs: Which life skill do you think is the most important for young people?
Should parents rather than schools be responsible for teaching these skills?

topics.t: Has social media done more harm than good to democracy?
outline: 立場: No(良い面のほうが大きい)
理由1: だれでも意見を発信でき、政治への参加が広がった
理由2: ただし偽情報や意見の分断という問題もある
まとめ: 利用者と企業の両方が責任を持てば民主主義を強められる
qs: How can people avoid seeing only opinions they already agree with?
Should politicians use social media to communicate with voters?

topics.t: Should Japan make English an official second language?
outline: 立場: No
理由1: 国民の大半は日常で英語を使わず、行政のコストが大きい
理由2: 日本語と日本文化を大切にする視点も必要
まとめ: 公用語にするより、話す力を伸ばす教育に力を入れるべき
qs: How could English education in Japan be improved?
Will translation technology make learning languages less important?

topics.t: Is it the government's responsibility to ensure food security?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 食料の多くを輸入に頼っており、国際情勢で価格が急に上がる
理由2: 農家の減少は個人や企業だけでは止められない
まとめ: 国内生産の支援と輸入先の分散を進めるべき
qs: Should people in Japan eat more locally produced food?
How can young people be encouraged to become farmers?

topics.t: Should self-driving cars be allowed on public roads?
outline: 立場: Yes(条件つきで)
理由1: 人間のミスによる事故を大きく減らせる可能性がある
理由2: 高齢者や地方の交通手段の問題を解決できる
まとめ: 事故の責任の所在など、法律の整備が先に必要
qs: Who should be responsible when a self-driving car causes an accident?
Would you feel safe riding in a self-driving car?

topics.t: Should the voting age be lowered to 16?
outline: 立場: No
理由1: 16歳では社会経験が少なく、周りの意見に影響されやすい
理由2: 18歳への引き下げの効果をまず確かめるべき
まとめ: 投票年齢よりも、学校での主権者教育を充実させるべき
qs: Why do you think many young people do not vote?
Should schools discuss political issues in class?

topics.t: Is a cashless society desirable?
outline: 立場: Yes(ただし配慮が必要)
理由1: 支払いが速くなり、お店も現金を扱うコストを減らせる
理由2: しかし高齢者や災害時の停電への備えが必要
まとめ: 現金も使える選択肢を残しながら進めるべき
qs: Are you worried about the security of electronic payments?
How would a cashless society affect elderly people?

topics.t: Should esports be recognized as a real sport?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 高い集中力・戦略・チームワークが求められる
理由2: 世界中に選手と観客がいて、大きな産業になっている
まとめ: 健康への配慮(長時間のプレー)もセットで考えるべき
qs: Should esports be included in the Olympics?
Do video games have educational value?

topics.t: Can art and culture help solve social problems?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 映画や音楽は、差別や貧困などの問題に人々の目を向けさせる
理由2: 芸術活動は地域のつながりを強め、町の活性化にもなる
まとめ: 政府も文化への支援を続けるべき
qs: Should the government spend more money on the arts?
Can you think of a work of art that changed public opinion?

topics.t: Should the very rich pay much higher taxes?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 所得の格差が広がり、社会の不安定さにつながっている
理由2: その税収を教育や医療に使えば、多くの人が機会を得られる
まとめ: ただし資産の海外流出を防ぐ国際協力も必要
qs: Would higher taxes discourage people from starting businesses?
What should the government spend the extra money on?

topics.t: Will big cities remain attractive places to live in the future?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 仕事・教育・医療などの機会が集中している
理由2: ただしリモートワークで地方に住む選択肢も広がっている
まとめ: 都市は残るが、住む場所の選び方は多様になる
qs: What are the biggest problems of living in a big city?
How can rural areas attract more young people?

topics.t: Is lifetime employment still valuable in Japan?
outline: 立場: 価値は小さくなっている
理由1: 技術の変化が速く、転職でスキルを高める人が増えている
理由2: ただし安定した雇用は生活設計や技術の継承に役立つ
まとめ: 安定と転職のしやすさを両立する仕組みが必要
qs: Do you think changing jobs often is a good idea?
What can companies do to keep talented workers?

topics.t: Should there be stricter regulations on artificial intelligence?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 偽の画像や音声が作られ、詐欺や偽情報に使われている
理由2: 判断の理由が見えないまま、採用や融資に使われるおそれ
まとめ: 発展を止めずに、透明性と責任を求めるルールを作るべき
qs: Should students be allowed to use AI to write essays?
Can international rules on AI really work?

topics.t: Should countries accept more refugees?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 命の危険から逃れてきた人を守るのは国際社会の責任
理由2: 受け入れた人々が働き手として社会に貢献することもできる
まとめ: 言語教育や仕事の支援など、受け入れ体制の整備が欠かせない
qs: What difficulties do refugees face in a new country?
How can a country's citizens be persuaded to support accepting refugees?

topics.t: Is it important to preserve local dialects?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 方言はその土地の歴史や文化を伝える大切な財産
理由2: 方言を話す高齢者が減り、記録しないと失われてしまう
まとめ: 学校や地域の行事で使う機会を増やすべき
qs: Do you think young people are interested in their local culture?
Should schools teach local history more?

ek1_free.q: Please tell me a little about yourself.
ek1_free.ja: 少し自己紹介をしてください。
model: I'm a student, and I'm interested in aviation. I'm studying English because I want to work as an international pilot.
points: 落ち着いて2〜3文

ek1_free.q: What are you interested in these days?
ek1_free.ja: 最近、何に興味がありますか。
model: Recently, I've been interested in new airplane technology, such as planes that use cleaner fuel.
points: 具体的に

ek1_free.q: How do you usually spend your weekends?
ek1_free.ja: ふだん週末をどう過ごしますか。
model: I usually study in the morning and go cycling in the afternoon. It helps me relax.
points: 具体的に2文

ek1_free.q: Why are you taking the Grade 1 test?
ek1_free.ja: なぜ1級を受けるのですか。
model: I want to use English in my future job, and I think this test is a good goal to aim for.
points: 理由をはっきり

ek1_free.q: What kind of books or articles do you read?
ek1_free.ja: どんな本や記事を読みますか。
model: I often read articles about science and technology. I also like history books.
points: ジャンル + 一言

ek1_free.ja: 海外に行ったことはありますか。
model: Yes, I went to Australia on a school trip. It was a great chance to use English.
points: Yes / No のあとに具体例

model: I'm from Chiba, near Tokyo. It's close to Narita Airport, so I often see planes flying over my town.
points: 地名 + 特徴を1〜2文

ek1_free.q: Are you a student, or do you work?
ek1_free.ja: 学生ですか、それとも働いていますか。
model: I'm a student. I'm studying hard because I want to go to a university with a strong English program.
points: どちらか + 少し詳しく

ek1_free.q: How did you prepare for this test?
ek1_free.ja: この試験に向けてどのように準備しましたか。
model: I read English news every day and practiced giving short speeches about social issues.
points: 具体的な方法を

ek1_free.q: What do you like to do to relax?
ek1_free.ja: リラックスするために何をするのが好きですか。
model: I like going cycling. Being outside helps me forget about stress.
points: 理由を添えて

ek1_free.q: Is there a place you would like to visit in the future?
ek1_free.ja: 将来行ってみたい場所はありますか。
model: Yes. I'd like to visit Iceland. I want to see the northern lights.
points: I'd like to ～ + 理由

ek1_free.q: What is the most interesting thing you have learned recently?
ek1_free.ja: 最近学んだ中でいちばんおもしろかったことは何ですか。
model: I learned that some airlines now use fuel made from cooking oil. I found it interesting because it can reduce emissions.
points: 内容 + なぜおもしろいか
